correctness.rationale: A connected vertex subset has a unique interval of occupied columns and a unique word over U,V,D avoiding the two forbidden adjacent singleton-row transitions. The 2-by-2 allowed-word matrix gives odd a_m and C_n parity n(n+1)/2. Odd counts force all Walsh coefficients odd. The signed recurrence follows by adjoining exactly the admissible final states; its explicitly displayed four-state cycle yields zero at every n congruent to 0 or 3 modulo 4, and magnitude one in every complementary order. The trivial character attains C_n, proving sharp invertible condition number C_n. The packaged standalone verifier passed 93,771 exact assertions, exhaustively comparing all frequencies through eight rungs.

Vince (2017) and Vince (2020) already supply the Pell/word counts; their unsigned total and elementary parity account for the sufficient invertibility direction, not the converse. The new piece is a single explicit four-periodic signed vertex assignment proving all remaining singularities, plus sharp invertible minimum multiplier magnitude one. value.rationale: This supplies a complete infinite exact recovery/singularity classification for a natural graph connectivity ensemble, not merely total enumeration. The all-size cancellation witness is structurally nontrivial; it explains every singular residue class and attains the sharp inverse spectral gap at all invertible orders. Potential uses are rigorous recoverability and conditioning for XOR-encoded connected-set signals on strip graphs, not an unproved generalization to larger widths.
